name: Missteps
body:
School necromancy; Level bard 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You fascinate ability a minor jinx of clumsiness on the target creature, reducing all its speed ratings by 10 feet (to a minimum of 5 feet) and bestowing a –2 penalty to the creature’s Dexterity (minimum 1).
